dedupe_keys.name: rail baltica design guidelines railway substructure part 1 embankments and earthworks

description: This design guideline sets the minimum requirements for designing the earthworks of the Rail Baltica railway line and its maintenance roads. Dated 6 May 2025 (document RBDG-MAN-015-0106, 47 pages), it lists the project constraints: a design speed of 249 km/h that raises safety and durability requirements, a wide range of temperature, frost and snow, marshy areas and marshlands with permanently high water levels, thixotropic and compressible soils including peat, groundwater near the surface, and potential countermeasures for climate-change-related issues. It covers design assumptions for earthwork volumes and cross sections, terminology for cuttings and embankments in damp areas and marshlands, and a strategy for reusing on-site materials. Coverage: the Rail Baltica corridor through Estonia, Latvia and Lithuania. Format and access: free PDF. Licence and cost: free; no licence is stated and the document notes EU funding. Caveats: some reference sections have been deleted intentionally. It supports climate adaptation and hazard exposure studies of new rail earthworks on soft soils. It relates to Network Rail earthworks management and RailSystemModel in the catalogue.
